content: Windows Job Objects: CreateJobObject + AssignProcessToJobObject associates a process; children created by an associated process auto-inherit job membership; TerminateJobObject or closing the job handle (with JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE) kills the whole tree. win32job crate wraps this safely (Job::create, limit_kill_on_job_close, set_extended_limit_info).
